run_f_gold: run f_gold to count unique cells in a binary matrix where each cell is the only non-zero in its row and column
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs to verify unique cell counting correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes row and column sums to find uniquely positioned non-zero cells
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the O(n*m) row and column sum computation for large matrices
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that counts cells with non-zero values unique in both their row and column
